text: Store realized harness cost on the idea next to its estimate (data model change)
description: Today a cycle's USD cost and tokens live in the trace (.bowman/runtime/traces, local, newest 200). For the priority-model calibration (b2a7c3cf: estimated vs actual on 30+ ideas) it must be durable in the graph. Proposal: optional field on an idea = summed realized cost of harness cycles that worked on it, added by the record stage; git versions it (no history arrays). Needs a migration per AGENTS.md (bump dataModelVersion, fixture of the previous format), plus a decision on the unit.

status.comment: Question for Felix: store realized cost on ideas in USD (what the harness measures), or in the project's abstract cost unit (what estimates use)? Options: (a) USD field `realizedCostUsd`, calibration converts with a configurable rate; (b) cost-unit field, with the USD-per-unit rate in meta.json; (c) no data model change: keep it in traces and export a calibration CSV.
